Article 23 – Prohibits human trafficking and forced labour.
Article 24 – Prohibits employment of children below 14 years in hazardous industries.
Article 24 – Prohibits employment of children below 14 years in hazardous industries.

items: Article 23 deals with human trafficking and forced labour, whereas Article 24 focuses on child labor prohibition.
The threshold age for employment prohibition in hazardous industries under Article 24 is strictly below 14 years.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Article 23 strictly prohibits human trafficking and forced labour.
Article 24 prohibits the employment of children below 14 years in hazardous industries.
Together, Articles 23 and 24 constitute the Right Against Exploitation under the Fundamental Rights.
